title: fix(metadata-protocol): a metadata row records who created it and who last changed it
body:
Fixes #23033
Clause-②: no

`SysMetadataRepository.put` now writes the actor onto the `sys_metadata` row. It stamps `created_by` when the row is first written and `updated_by` on every write, both from `PutOptions.actor`, as the repository's own header mapping (`actor → updated_by`) declares. A write with no actor stores NULL in both columns, never a placeholder user. History's `recorded_by` is unchanged. This follows the triage direction (comment 6124803255).

## Measured first, on `origin/main` `df7a137923`

- **Reproduced.** Saving through the metadata door (`saveMetaItem` with `actor: 'usr_alice'`) on a real kernel (`ObjectQLPlugin`: the real engine, the real audit hooks, the real `sys_metadata` declaration) left `created_by` and `updated_by` **absent** on the stored row (`expected undefined to be 'usr_alice'`, 3 of the 4 new real-engine pins red). The history row's `recorded_by` carried the actor (the existing #4556 pins stayed green).
- **Why.** `put()` built `parentRowData` with neither column and wrote it with `context: { ...ctx, isSystem: true }`, a context that carries no user. The engine's audit hooks (`sys_stamp_audit_insert` and `sys_stamp_audit_update` in `objectql/src/plugin.ts`) stamp the `*_by` pair only inside `if (session?.userId)`, so they wrote nothing either.
- **Does the engine strip or overwrite a client-supplied pair on an `isSystem` write?** No. With no `session.userId` the hooks assign nothing, and `isSystem` exempts the write from the static-readonly strip on insert and on update (`created_by` is `readonly: true` on `sys_metadata`). So the pins read the row the driver stored, not the payload. The real-engine file exists to pin exactly this.
- **What callers pass as `actor`.** The REST `/meta` doors pass the authenticated user id or `undefined` (`resolveMetaWriteActor`, #7749 and #7941; `'system'` is only the audit-row default, `recordMetadataAudit`). `saveMetaItem` forwards `request.actor ?? null`, `promoteDraft` and `restoreVersion` forward their own `actor`, and boot or internal writes pass none. The columns are `lookup('sys_user')`. Under `isSystem` the engine runs no reference check, so a non-user string would be stored as given. The repository stamps exactly what `recorded_by` already records: one value, two columns. See the acceptance notes for the one producer that passes a label.

## Other writers of the parent row in this class

- `put`: the insert and the update, both stamped (the only two `engine.insert` / `engine.update` calls on `sys_metadata` in the class).
- `promoteDraft` and `restoreVersion`: both write the active row through `put(..., { actor: opts.actor })`, so they get the same stamp. A publish or a restore that creates the active row records its own actor as `created_by`; one that updates the row moves `updated_by`.
- `delete` and `dropPromotedDraftRow`: both hard-delete the row, so no row is left to stamp. The tombstone's `recorded_by` keeps the actor, as before.
- The read side needed no change. `rowToItem`'s `authoredBy` and `listDrafts`' `updatedBy` read `updated_by ?? created_by ?? null`, and with the write side stamping, both name the last writer (pinned below).

## Change

- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/sys-metadata-repository.ts`: `updated_by: opts.actor ?? null` in the row `put()` builds, and `created_by = opts.actor ?? null` on the insert branch only, beside the existing `updated_at` / `created_at`. The header's mapping table gains the `created_by` row.
- `.changeset/23033-metadata-row-actor.md`: `patch` for `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`.

## Pins

- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/sys-metadata-repository.recorded-by.test.ts`: a new `#23033` block beside the #4556 pins, on the file's existing engine double (no new double, no ledger change). It covers first write A, then A/A; second write B, then A/B with history `[A, B]`; no actor, then NULL/NULL; an authored write followed by an actor-less one, then A/NULL; and the read side (`get().authoredBy` and `listDrafts().updatedBy` name the last writer).
- `packages/objectql/src/protocol-metadata-row-actor.test.ts` (new): the same rule through the door, read off the row the real engine stored. It covers first write A, then A/A with history `[A]`; second write B, then A/B with history `[A, B]`; the CONTROL (no actor, then both null, history `[null]`); and `listDrafts` answering `updatedBy` from the draft row. It sits in `objectql` because `metadata-protocol` must not depend on `objectql`, the same reason `plugin.authoring-channel.test.ts` sits there.
- **Ablation** (fix committed first; script `trap`-guarded; restore by `git checkout HEAD --`, proved by blob == HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`). Both stamp lines were deleted through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor 1 to 0 each), `metadata-protocol` was rebuilt, and `ablation-dist-preflight --absent` confirmed both markers were gone from `dist/`.
  - Repository pins: 5 red, and the 8 #4556 pins stayed green.
  - Real-engine pins: 3 red, and the no-actor CONTROL stayed green.
  - Restore: rebuilt, both markers present in `dist/index.js`, whole tree clean, 13/13 and 4/4 green.

## Verification (head `d4ac870f46`, after merging `origin/main` `0cbfb7c32c`)

- `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` `vitest run`: 227 files passed, 3 skipped; 28197 tests passed. `typecheck` (`tsc --noEmit`, `include: src/**/*`, tests included): exit 0.
- `@objectstack/objectql` `vitest run --project local`: 407 files passed, 7940 tests passed. `typecheck` (`tsc --noEmit && check:test-typecheck`): exit 0, and the new test file compiles under `tsconfig.test.json` with no debt entry.
- Gates: the dispatch list (53 commands) plus the 13 added by re-derivation on the real diff (changeset families), 66 in all, each exit captured before any pipe. All exit 0 except `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, which is **NOT MEASURED**: it printed `PREREQUISITE NOT MET` because the whole workspace's `dist/` is not built in this worktree, and CI runs it.
- `integration`-tier and other whole-tree runs are left to CI.

## Acceptance notes

- **A producer passes a label as `actor` (out of scope here; reported for the seat to file).** `migrateStoredMetadata` defaults `actor` to `'migrate-stored'`, and its three callers pass labels, not user ids: `POST /meta/_migrate-stored` passes `'USER (POST PREFIX/_migrate-stored)'` (`rest-server.ts`), the runtime door passes the same shape (`runtime/src/domains/meta.ts`), and the CLI passes `'os migrate meta --stored'`. `PutOptions.actor` declares the value lands in a `lookup('sys_user')` and must be `null`, never a label, when there is no user id. Those labels already reach `recorded_by`. With this change they also reach `updated_by` on the rows the pass rewrites. The repository cannot tell a label from a user id, and contract-first puts the fix at the producer, which also lies outside this card's file surface. The fix is to pass the user id or `null` and carry the door's name in `source`.
- **A second writer of `sys_metadata` lives outside this class.** `persistDatasourceRow` (`service-datasource/src/datasource-admin-plugin.ts`) inserts and updates the row directly, with no actor in hand and no history row. A `/meta`-written datasource row that is later edited through the datasource admin door keeps the `/meta` writer's `updated_by` (read from the code, not run). Not touched; there is no carrier.
- The install request's actor field (`InstallPackageRequestSchema`) is a new contract key and is deliberately not here, per triage.
- Rows written before this release keep null columns until their next write. Nothing backfills them, since history alone knows the writer.
